from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import os
import re
import sys
import types
import warnings
from dataclasses import asdict
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd


REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
RAW_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "db/rules_ingestion/data/raw/20260622/tushare/fut_basic"
STATIC_META_YAML_DIR = (
    REPO_ROOT / "db/rules_ingestion/data/derived/20260624/product_meta_static/yaml"
)
OUTPUT_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "db/rules_ingestion/data/derived/20260624/instrument_registry"
AUDIT_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / "AUDIT.md"
SOURCE_TO_LOCAL_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / "tushare_ts_code_to_instrument.parquet"

EXCHANGES = ["SHFE", "INE", "DCE", "CZCE", "GFEX", "CFFEX"]
OUTPUT_COLUMNS = [
    "instrument",
    "product",
    "exchange",
    "list_date",
    "last_trade_date",
    "delivery_year",
    "delivery_month",
    "end_deliv_date",
    "exchange_inst",
    "multiplier",
]

CONTRACT_CODE_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z]+[0-9]{3,4}$")


def normalize_exchange(exchange: Any) -> str:
    value = str(exchange).strip().upper()
    mapping = {
        "SHF": "SHFE",
        "CZC": "CZCE",
        "ZCE": "CZCE",
        "CFE": "CFFEX",
        "CFX": "CFFEX",
        "GFE": "GFEX",
    }
    return mapping.get(value, value)


def parse_yyyymmdd(value: Any) -> date | None:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    parsed = pd.to_datetime(text, format="%Y%m%d", errors="coerce")
    if pd.isna(parsed):
        parsed = pd.to_datetime(text, errors="coerce")
    if pd.isna(parsed):
        return None
    return parsed.date()


def parse_d_month(value: Any) -> tuple[int | None, int | None]:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None, None
    text = str(value).strip()
    if text.endswith(".0"):
        text = text[:-2]
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{6}", text):
        return None, None
    return int(text[:4]), int(text[4:6])


def parse_intish(value: Any) -> int | None:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    parsed = pd.to_numeric(value, errors="coerce")
    if pd.isna(parsed):
        return None
    if abs(float(parsed) - round(float(parsed))) > 1e-9:
        return None
    return int(round(float(parsed)))


def source_instrument(row: pd.Series) -> str:
    ts_code = str(row["ts_code"]).strip().upper()
    if "." in ts_code:
        return ts_code.split(".", 1)[0]
    return str(row["symbol"]).strip().upper()


def format_exchange_inst(symbol: Any, exchange: str) -> str:
    value = str(symbol).strip().upper()
    if exchange in {"CFFEX", "CZCE"}:
        return value
    return value.lower()


def rejection_reason(row: pd.Series, instrument: str) -> str | None:
    fut_code = str(row.get("fut_code", "")).strip().upper()
    symbol = str(row.get("symbol", "")).strip().upper()
    ts_code = str(row.get("ts_code", "")).strip().upper()
    if "TAS" in fut_code or symbol.endswith("TAS") or "TAS" in ts_code:
        return "tas_contract_not_plain_futures"
    if not CONTRACT_CODE_RE.fullmatch(instrument):
        return "non_plain_futures_contract_code"
    if row[["list_date", "delist_date", "d_month"]].isna().any():
        return "missing_lifecycle_or_delivery_month"
    return None


def load_static_products() -> set[str]:
    if not STATIC_META_YAML_DIR.exists():
        return set()
    return {path.stem.upper() for path in STATIC_META_YAML_DIR.glob("*.yaml")}


def load_raw() -> pd.DataFrame:
    frames: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    for path in sorted(RAW_DIR.glob("*.parquet")):
        df = pd.read_parquet(path)
        df["source_file"] = path.name
        frames.append(df)
    if not frames:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No fut_basic parquet files found under {RAW_DIR}")
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.filterwarnings(
            "ignore",
            message="The behavior of DataFrame concatenation with empty or all-NA entries is deprecated.*",
            category=FutureWarning,
        )
        return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)


def build_registry(raw: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    mapping_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    rejected_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    invalid_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for _, row in raw.iterrows():
        instrument = source_instrument(row)
        exchange = normalize_exchange(row["exchange"])
        reason = rejection_reason(row, instrument)
        if reason is not None:
            rejected_rows.append(
                {
                    "ts_code": row.get("ts_code"),
                    "symbol": row.get("symbol"),
                    "instrument_candidate": instrument,
                    "exchange": exchange,
                    "fut_code": row.get("fut_code"),
                    "name": row.get("name"),
                    "reason": reason,
                }
            )
            continue

        product = str(row["fut_code"]).strip().upper()
        delivery_year, delivery_month = parse_d_month(row["d_month"])
        multiplier_source = "multiplier" if exchange == "CFFEX" else "per_unit"
        multiplier = parse_intish(row[multiplier_source])
        out_row = {
            "instrument": instrument,
            "product": product,
            "exchange": exchange,
            "list_date": parse_yyyymmdd(row["list_date"]),
            "last_trade_date": parse_yyyymmdd(row["delist_date"]),
            "delivery_year": delivery_year,
            "delivery_month": delivery_month,
            "end_deliv_date": parse_yyyymmdd(row["last_ddate"]),
            "exchange_inst": format_exchange_inst(row["symbol"], exchange),
            "multiplier": multiplier,
        }

        invalid_reasons: list[str] = []
        if exchange not in EXCHANGES:
            invalid_reasons.append("unsupported_exchange")
        if not instrument.startswith(product):
            invalid_reasons.append("instrument_product_prefix_mismatch")
        for field in [
            "list_date",
            "last_trade_date",
            "delivery_year",
            "delivery_month",
            "exchange_inst",
            "multiplier",
        ]:
            if out_row[field] is None:
                invalid_reasons.append(f"missing_{field}")
        if not out_row["exchange_inst"]:
            invalid_reasons.append("missing_exchange_inst")
        if out_row["delivery_month"] is not None and not (1 <= out_row["delivery_month"] <= 12):
            invalid_reasons.append("invalid_delivery_month")
        if out_row["list_date"] and out_row["last_trade_date"]:
            if out_row["list_date"] > out_row["last_trade_date"]:
                invalid_reasons.append("list_date_after_last_trade_date")
        if out_row["multiplier"] is not None and out_row["multiplier"] <= 0:
            invalid_reasons.append("non_positive_multiplier")

        if invalid_reasons:
            invalid_row = dict(out_row)
            invalid_row["ts_code"] = row.get("ts_code")
            invalid_row["symbol"] = row.get("symbol")
            invalid_row["invalid_reasons"] = ";".join(invalid_reasons)
            invalid_rows.append(invalid_row)
            continue

        rows.append(out_row)
        mapping_rows.append(
            {
                "ts_code": str(row["ts_code"]).strip().upper(),
                "instrument": instrument,
            }
        )

    registry = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=OUTPUT_COLUMNS)
    source_to_local = pd.DataFrame(mapping_rows, columns=["ts_code", "instrument"])
    rejected = pd.DataFrame(rejected_rows)
    invalid = pd.DataFrame(invalid_rows)
    if not registry.empty:
        registry = registry.sort_values(["exchange", "product", "delivery_year", "delivery_month", "instrument"])
    if not source_to_local.empty:
        source_to_local = source_to_local.sort_values(["ts_code", "instrument"])
    return registry, source_to_local, rejected, invalid


def write_outputs(registry: pd.DataFrame, source_to_local: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, int]:
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for exchange in EXCHANGES:
        part = registry.loc[registry["exchange"] == exchange, OUTPUT_COLUMNS].copy()
        path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{exchange}.parquet"
        part.to_parquet(path, index=False)
        counts[exchange] = len(part)
    source_to_local.to_parquet(SOURCE_TO_LOCAL_PATH, index=False)
    return counts


def install_isolated_data_rules_modules() -> None:
    data_mod = types.ModuleType("data")
    data_mod.__path__ = [str(REPO_ROOT / "data")]
    rules_mod = types.ModuleType("data.rules")
    rules_mod.__path__ = [str(REPO_ROOT / "data/rules")]
    sys.modules["data"] = data_mod
    sys.modules["data.rules"] = rules_mod

    models_path = REPO_ROOT / "data/rules/models.py"
    models_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("data.rules.models", models_path)
    if models_spec is None or models_spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot load {models_path}")
    models_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(models_spec)
    sys.modules["data.rules.models"] = models_module
    models_spec.loader.exec_module(models_module)


def validate_with_manager(registry: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, Any]:
    install_isolated_data_rules_modules()
    manager_path = REPO_ROOT / "data/rules/instrument_registry_manager.py"
    manager_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "data.rules.instrument_registry_manager", manager_path
    )
    if manager_spec is None or manager_spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot load {manager_path}")
    manager_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(manager_spec)
    sys.modules["data.rules.instrument_registry_manager"] = manager_module
    manager_spec.loader.exec_module(manager_module)
    manager = manager_module.InstrumentRegistryManager(str(OUTPUT_DIR))

    samples: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    old_cwd = Path.cwd()
    try:
        os.chdir(OUTPUT_DIR)
        for exchange, part in registry.groupby("exchange"):
            sample_instrument = str(part.iloc[0]["instrument"])
            samples[exchange] = asdict(manager.get_instrument_registry(sample_instrument))
        manager._load_all()
        loaded_rows = len(manager._registry_df) if manager._registry_df is not None else 0
    finally:
        os.chdir(old_cwd)
    return {"loaded_rows": loaded_rows, "sample_objects": samples}


def markdown_table(df: pd.DataFrame, columns: list[str], max_rows: int = 12) -> str:
    if df.empty:
        return "_None._"
    clipped = df.loc[:, columns].head(max_rows).copy()
    return clipped.to_markdown(index=False)


def write_audit(
    raw: pd.DataFrame,
    registry: pd.DataFrame,
    source_to_local: pd.DataFrame,
    rejected: pd.DataFrame,
    invalid: pd.DataFrame,
    output_counts: dict[str, int],
    manager_validation: dict[str, Any],
    static_products: set[str],
) -> None:
    products = set(registry["product"].unique())
    missing_static_products = sorted(products - static_products)
    duplicate_instruments = registry.loc[
        registry["instrument"].duplicated(keep=False), ["instrument", "product", "exchange"]
    ]
    exchange_inst_mismatch = registry.loc[
        registry["instrument"] != registry["exchange_inst"],
        ["instrument", "exchange_inst", "product", "exchange", "delivery_year", "delivery_month"],
    ]
    duplicate_exchange_inst = registry.loc[
        registry.duplicated(["exchange", "exchange_inst"], keep=False),
        ["instrument", "exchange_inst", "product", "exchange", "delivery_year", "delivery_month"],
    ].sort_values(["exchange", "exchange_inst", "instrument"])
    exchange_inst_case_violations = registry.loc[
        (
            registry["exchange"].isin(["CFFEX", "CZCE"])
            & (registry["exchange_inst"] != registry["exchange_inst"].str.upper())
        )
        | (
            registry["exchange"].isin(["SHFE", "DCE", "GFEX", "INE"])
            & (registry["exchange_inst"] != registry["exchange_inst"].str.lower())
        ),
        ["instrument", "exchange_inst", "product", "exchange", "delivery_year", "delivery_month"],
    ]
    symbol_duplicates = raw.assign(instrument_candidate=raw.apply(source_instrument, axis=1))
    raw_symbol_duplicates = symbol_duplicates.loc[
        symbol_duplicates["symbol"].astype(str).str.upper().duplicated(keep=False),
        ["ts_code", "symbol", "exchange", "fut_code", "name"],
    ].sort_values(["symbol", "ts_code"])

    rejected_counts = (
        rejected["reason"].value_counts().rename_axis("reason").reset_index(name="rows")
        if not rejected.empty
        else pd.DataFrame(columns=["reason", "rows"])
    )
    exchange_counts = pd.DataFrame(
        [{"exchange": exchange, "rows": count} for exchange, count in output_counts.items()]
    )

    lines = [
        "# Instrument Registry TIER2 Ingestion Audit",
        "",
        "- Run date: 2026-06-27",
        f"- Raw source: `{RAW_DIR.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)}`",
        f"- Output directory: `{OUTPUT_DIR.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)}`",
        f"- Source-to-local mapping: `{SOURCE_TO_LOCAL_PATH.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)}`",
        "- Script: `db/rules_ingestion/script/instrument_registry/ingest_instrument_registry.py`",
        "",
        "## Scope",
        "",
        "Generated one registry parquet per exchange for the current `InstrumentRegistry` model fields: "
        "`instrument`, `product`, `exchange`, `list_date`, `last_trade_date`, "
        "`delivery_year`, `delivery_month`, `end_deliv_date`, `exchange_inst`, `multiplier`.",
        "",
        "## Inputs And Outputs",
        "",
        f"- Raw rows read: {len(raw)}",
        f"- Accepted registry rows: {len(registry)}",
        f"- Source-to-local mapping rows: {len(source_to_local)}",
        f"- Rejected rows: {len(rejected)}",
        f"- Invalid accepted-candidate rows dropped after field validation: {len(invalid)}",
        "",
        markdown_table(exchange_counts, ["exchange", "rows"]),
        "",
        "## Plan Deviations And Operator Judgement",
        "",
        "1. `instrument` was generated from the `ts_code` prefix before the dot instead of always using "
        "`symbol`. This is required because CZCE `symbol` collapses decade information and creates "
        "duplicate local instruments, for example `CF1001.ZCE` and `CF2001.ZCE` both have `symbol=CF001`. "
        "For most non-CZCE records the `ts_code` prefix equals `symbol`; for CZCE it preserves the full "
        "delivery year and satisfies the manager's all-market uniqueness constraint.",
        "2. `exchange_inst` was derived from Tushare `symbol`, then normalized to the exchange order-code "
        "case convention: CFFEX/CZCE product letters stay uppercase, while SHFE/DCE/GFEX/INE product "
        "letters are lowercase. It is the source exchange/order-code field, while `instrument` remains "
        "the local all-market primary key. Repeated `exchange_inst` values are expected for CZCE "
        "cross-decade contracts and are not treated as validation failures.",
        "3. Plain futures contracts were accepted only when the canonical instrument matched "
        "`^[A-Z]+[0-9]{3,4}$`, with an explicit TAS exclusion because INE TAS contracts such as "
        "`SCTAS2102` otherwise look like ordinary letter-plus-digit instruments after `ts_code` "
        "normalization. This drops main, continuous, index-like, DCE month-average (`*F`) and INE TAS "
        "records from the registry universe.",
        "4. Products present in Tushare ordinary futures contracts but absent from the current TIER1 "
        "static YAML set were retained in TIER2 and listed below for audit. The plan states this as a "
        "validation expectation, but TIER2's modified plan also defines Tushare `fut_basic` as the "
        "universe source. Dropping historical or newly listed ordinary contracts here would make the "
        "registry less faithful to its only source.",
        "",
        "## Rejection Summary",
        "",
        markdown_table(rejected_counts, ["reason", "rows"]),
        "",

        markdown_table(

        f"- Expected loaded rows: {len(registry)}",

        f"- Products in output: {len(products)}",
        f"- Products missing current TIER1 static YAML: {', '.join(missing_static_products) if missing_static_products else 'None'}",
        "",
        "Raw `symbol` duplicates were observed before using `ts_code` as the canonical instrument. Sample:",
        "",

        "",
        "`instrument != exchange_inst` samples:",
        "",
        markdown_table(

            ["instrument", "exchange_inst", "product", "exchange", "delivery_year", "delivery_month"],
        ),
        "",
        "`exchange_inst` case convention violation samples:",
        "",
        markdown_table(
            exchange_inst_case_violations,
            ["instrument", "exchange_inst", "product", "exchange", "delivery_year", "delivery_month"],

        "",
        "Duplicated `(exchange, exchange_inst)` samples:",
        "",

            ["instrument", "exchange_inst", "product", "exchange", "delivery_year", "delivery_month"],
        ),
        "",
        "Invalid accepted-candidate rows:",
        "",
        markdown_table(
            invalid,
            [
                "ts_code",
                "symbol",
                "instrument",
                "product",
                "exchange",
                "exchange_inst",
                "invalid_reasons",
            ],
        ),
        "",
        "Manager sample objects:",
        "",
        "```text",
    ]
    for exchange, sample in manager_validation["sample_objects"].items():
        lines.append(f"{exchange}: {sample}")
    lines.extend(["```", ""])

    AUDIT_PATH.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> None:
    raw = load_raw()
    static_products = load_static_products()
    registry, source_to_local, rejected, invalid = build_registry(raw)

    duplicate_instruments = registry["instrument"].duplicated(keep=False)
    if duplicate_instruments.any():
        duplicated = registry.loc[duplicate_instruments, "instrument"].head(20).tolist()
        raise ValueError(f"Duplicate output instruments remain: {duplicated}")
    if not invalid.empty:
        invalid_preview = invalid.head(20).to_dict("records")
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid accepted-candidate rows remain: {invalid_preview}")

    if source_to_local["ts_code"].duplicated().any():
        duplicated = source_to_local.loc[
            source_to_local["ts_code"].duplicated(keep=False), "ts_code"
        ].head(20).tolist()
        raise ValueError(f"Duplicate source ts_code values remain in mapping: {duplicated}")
    if source_to_local["instrument"].duplicated().any():
        duplicated = source_to_local.loc[
            source_to_local["instrument"].duplicated(keep=False), "instrument"
        ].head(20).tolist()
        raise ValueError(f"Duplicate local instrument values remain in mapping: {duplicated}")

    output_counts = write_outputs(registry, source_to_local)
    manager_validation = validate_with_manager(registry)
    if manager_validation["loaded_rows"] != len(registry):
        raise ValueError(
            f"Manager loaded {manager_validation['loaded_rows']} rows, expected {len(registry)}"
        )

    write_audit(
        raw=raw,
        registry=registry,
        source_to_local=source_to_local,
        rejected=rejected,
        invalid=invalid,
        output_counts=output_counts,
        manager_validation=manager_validation,
        static_products=static_products,
    )

    print(f"Wrote {len(registry)} registry rows to {OUTPUT_DIR}")
    print(f"Wrote audit to {AUDIT_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def product_universe() -> list[str]:
    return sorted(path.stem.upper() for path in STATIC_YAML_DIR.glob("*.yaml"))


def read_listing_dates() -> dict[str, str]:
    pattern = re.compile(r"\| `([^`]+)` \| [^|]+ \| ([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}) \|")
    listing_dates: dict[str, str] = {}
    for line in LISTING_DATES_DOC.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        match = pattern.match(line.strip())
        if match:
            product, list_date = match.groups()
            listing_dates[product.upper()] = list_date
    return listing_dates

    df = pd.read_parquet(RAW_PRODUCT_INFO)
    df["product"] = df["code"].astype(str).str.upper()

def build_product_tick_lookup(product_info: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, float]:
    lookup: dict[str, float] = {}
    for row in product_info.itertuples(index=False):
        if pd.isna(row.price_tick):
            continue
        lookup[row.product] = float(row.price_tick)
    return lookup


def with_listing_date(product: str, history: list[dict[str, Any]], listing_dates: dict[str, str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if product not in listing_dates:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing listing date for {product} in {LISTING_DATES_DOC}")
    result = [dict(item) for item in history]
    result[0]["effective_date"] = listing_dates[product]
    return result


def build_histories(
    products: list[str], product_tick: dict[str, float], listing_dates: dict[str, str]
) -> tuple[dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]], pd.DataFrame]:
    histories: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    audit_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for product in products:
        if product in RESEARCH_REPORT_HISTORIES:
            history = with_listing_date(product, RESEARCH_REPORT_HISTORIES[product], listing_dates)
            source = "research_report_history"
            note = ""
        else:
            tick = product_tick.get(product)
            if tick is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing price_tick for {product} in {RAW_PRODUCT_INFO}")
            history = [{"effective_date": listing_dates[product], "price_tick": tick}]
            source = "bigquant_current_single_version"
            note = REPORT_NOT_REAL_CHANGES.get(product, "")

        histories[product] = history
        audit_rows.append(
            {
                "product": product,
                "source": source,
                "versions": len(history),
                "first_effective_date": history[0]["effective_date"],
                "latest_effective_date": history[-1]["effective_date"],
                "latest_price_tick": history[-1]["price_tick"],
                "note": note,
            }
        )

    return histories, pd.DataFrame(audit_rows)

    count = 0
    for product, history in sorted(histories.items()):
        payload = {"price_tick_history": history}
        with open(YAML_DIR / f"{product}.yaml", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:

@dataclass(frozen=True)

def normalize_exchange(value: Any) -> str | None:

        return None
    return EXCHANGE_ALIASES.get(str(value).strip().upper())


def normalize_product(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    return text.upper()


def unique_non_null(values: pd.Series) -> list[str]:
    if values.empty:
        return []
    return sorted({str(v) for v in values.dropna().tolist()})


def mode_value(values: pd.Series) -> Any:
    clean = values.dropna()
    if clean.empty:
        return None
    counts = clean.value_counts()
    return counts[counts == counts.max()].sort_index().index[-1]


def latest_mode(df: pd.DataFrame, column: str) -> Any:
    if df.empty or column not in df.columns:
        return None
    work = df.dropna(subset=[column])
    if work.empty:
        return None
    if "trading_day" in work.columns:
        latest_day = work["trading_day"].max()
        latest = work[work["trading_day"] == latest_day]
        value = mode_value(latest[column])
        if value is not None:
            return value
    return mode_value(work[column])


def read_product_info() -> pd.DataFrame:
    path = RAW_ROOT / "bigquant" / "cn_future_product_info" / "full.parquet"
    df = pd.read_parquet(path)
    df["exchange_local"] = df["exchange"].map(normalize_exchange)
    df["product_local"] = df["code"].map(normalize_product)
    return df


def read_basic_info() -> pd.DataFrame:
    paths = sorted((RAW_ROOT / "bigquant" / "cn_future_basic_info").glob("exchange=*.parquet"))
    frames = [pd.read_parquet(path) for path in paths]
    df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    df["exchange_local"] = df["exchange"].map(normalize_exchange)
    df["product_local"] = df["product_code"].map(normalize_product)
    return df


def read_static_data() -> pd.DataFrame:
    paths = sorted((RAW_ROOT / "bigquant" / "cn_future_static_data").glob("exchange=*/product=*.parquet"))
    frames: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    for path in paths:
        df = pd.read_parquet(path)
        df["source_path"] = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
        frames.append(df)
    df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    df["exchange_local"] = df["exchange"].map(normalize_exchange)
    df["product_local"] = df["product_id"].map(normalize_product)
    return df


def build_name_lookup(product_info: pd.DataFrame, basic_info: pd.DataFrame, static_data: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[ProductKey, str]:
    result: dict[ProductKey, str] = {}
    for row in product_info.dropna(subset=["exchange_local", "product_local"]).itertuples(index=False):
        if row.exchange_local in VALID_EXCHANGES and isinstance(row.name, str) and row.name.strip():
            result[ProductKey(row.exchange_local, row.product_local)] = row.name.strip()

    for source in (basic_info, static_data):
        for (exchange, product), group in source.dropna(subset=["exchange_local", "product_local"]).groupby(
            ["exchange_local", "product_local"]
        ):
            key = ProductKey(exchange, product)
            if key in result:
                continue
            names = unique_non_null(group["name"])
            if names:
                result[key] = names[0]
    return result


def build_candidates(product_info: pd.DataFrame, basic_info: pd.DataFrame, static_data: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    basic_products = {
        ProductKey(exchange, product)
        for exchange, product in basic_info.dropna(subset=["exchange_local", "product_local"])[
            ["exchange_local", "product_local"]
        ].itertuples(index=False, name=None)
        if exchange in VALID_EXCHANGES
    }
    static_products = {
        ProductKey(exchange, product)
        for exchange, product in static_data.dropna(subset=["exchange_local", "product_local"])[
            ["exchange_local", "product_local"]
        ].drop_duplicates()
        .itertuples(index=False, name=None)
        if exchange in VALID_EXCHANGES
    }
    product_info_products = {
        ProductKey(exchange, product)
        for exchange, product in product_info.dropna(subset=["exchange_local", "product_local"])[
            ["exchange_local", "product_local"]
        ].itertuples(index=False, name=None)
        if exchange in VALID_EXCHANGES
    }

    eligible = sorted(basic_products & static_products, key=lambda k: (k.exchange, k.product))
    name_lookup = build_name_lookup(product_info, basic_info, static_data)

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    multi_value_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for key in eligible:
        group = static_data[
            (static_data["exchange_local"] == key.exchange) & (static_data["product_local"] == key.product)
        ].copy()
        group["trading_day"] = pd.to_numeric(group["trading_day"], errors="coerce")
        product_classes = unique_non_null(group["product_class"])
        if product_classes != ["1"]:
            rows.append(
                {
                    "product": key.product,
                    "exchange": key.exchange,
                    "status": "excluded",
                    "reason": f"non_plain_future_product_class={product_classes}",
                }
            )
            continue

        raw_position_date_type = latest_mode(group, "position_date_type")
        position_date_type = POSITION_DATE_TYPE_MAP.get(str(raw_position_date_type))
        max_margin_raw = latest_mode(group, "max_margin_side_algorithm")
        combination_raw = latest_mode(group, "combination_type")

        status = "ok"
        reason = ""
        if position_date_type is None:
            status = "needs_review"
            reason = f"unknown_position_date_type={raw_position_date_type}"
        if max_margin_raw is None or combination_raw is None:
            status = "needs_review"
            reason = "; ".join(filter(None, [reason, "missing_static_meta_value"]))

        for field in ["position_date_type", "max_margin_side_algorithm", "combination_type"]:
            values = unique_non_null(group[field])
            if len(values) > 1:
                multi_value_rows.append(
                    {
                        "product": key.product,
                        "exchange": key.exchange,
                        "field": field,
                        "values": "|".join(values),
                        "chosen_latest_mode": latest_mode(group, field),
                        "first_trading_day": int(group["trading_day"].min()),
                        "last_trading_day": int(group["trading_day"].max()),
                        "distinct_instruments": group["instrument"].nunique(dropna=True),
                    }
                )

        rows.append(
            {
                "product": key.product,
                "exchange": key.exchange,
                "name": name_lookup.get(key, ""),
                "position_date_type": position_date_type,
                "position_date_type_raw": raw_position_date_type,
                "max_margin_side_algorithm": bool(int(max_margin_raw)) if max_margin_raw is not None else None,
                "max_margin_side_algorithm_raw": max_margin_raw,
                "combination_type": int(combination_raw) if combination_raw is not None else None,
                "combination_type_raw": combination_raw,
                "status": status,
                "reason": reason,
                "has_product_info": key in product_info_products,
                "basic_instruments": int(
                    basic_info[
                        (basic_info["exchange_local"] == key.exchange) & (basic_info["product_local"] == key.product)
                    ]["instrument"].nunique(dropna=True)
                ),
                "static_rows": int(len(group)),
                "static_instruments": int(group["instrument"].nunique(dropna=True)),
                "first_trading_day": int(group["trading_day"].min()),
                "last_trading_day": int(group["trading_day"].max()),
            }
        )

    rejected_product_info = []
    for key in sorted(product_info_products - set(eligible), key=lambda k: (k.exchange, k.product)):
        reasons = []
        if key not in basic_products:
            reasons.append("missing_from_basic_info")
        if key not in static_products:
            reasons.append("missing_from_static_data")
        rejected_product_info.append(
            {
                "product": key.product,
                "exchange": key.exchange,
                "source": "cn_future_product_info",
                "reason": ";".join(reasons),
            }
        )
    for row in product_info[~product_info["exchange_local"].isin(VALID_EXCHANGES)].itertuples(index=False):
        rejected_product_info.append(
            {
                "product": row.product_local,
                "exchange": row.exchange,
                "source": "cn_future_product_info",
                "reason": "invalid_exchange_or_non_china_futures",
            }
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows), pd.DataFrame(multi_value_rows), pd.DataFrame(rejected_product_info)


def write_yaml(candidates: pd.DataFrame) -> int:
    YAML_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ok = candidates[candidates["status"].isin(["ok", "needs_review"])].copy()
    written = 0
    for row in ok.sort_values(["exchange", "product"]).itertuples(index=False):
        if not row.name or pd.isna(row.position_date_type):
            continue
        payload = {
            "product": row.product,
            "exchange": row.exchange,
            "name": row.name,
            "position_date_type": row.position_date_type,
            "max_margin_side_algorithm": bool(row.max_margin_side_algorithm),
            "combination_type": int(row.combination_type),
        }
        with open(YAML_DIR / f"{row.product}.yaml", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            yaml.safe_dump(payload, fh, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=False)
        written += 1
    return written


def write_report(candidates: pd.DataFrame, multi_values: pd.DataFrame, rejected: pd.DataFrame, yaml_count: int) -> None:
    OUT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    candidates.to_csv(OUT_ROOT / "candidate_static_meta.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    multi_values.to_csv(OUT_ROOT / "static_meta_multi_value_fields.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    rejected.to_csv(OUT_ROOT / "rejected_product_info_codes.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    by_exchange = candidates[candidates["status"].isin(["ok", "needs_review"])].groupby("exchange")["product"].count()
    lines = [
        "# StaticMeta Ingestion Audit",
        "",
        "- Batch: 20260624",
        "- Raw snapshot: `db/rules_ingestion/data/raw/20260622`",
        "- Variables: `StaticMeta.product`, `StaticMeta.exchange`, `StaticMeta.name`, `StaticMeta.position_date_type`, `StaticMeta.max_margin_side_algorithm`, `StaticMeta.combination_type`",
        f"- Candidate products: {int(candidates[candidates['status'].isin(['ok', 'needs_review'])].shape[0])}",
        f"- Candidate YAML files: {yaml_count}",
        f"- Rejected product-info rows/codes: {int(rejected.shape[0])}",
        f"- Product-field multi-value findings: {int(multi_values.shape[0])}",
        "",
        "## Candidate Products By Exchange",
        "",
    ]
    for exchange, count in by_exchange.items():
        lines.append(f"- {exchange}: {int(count)}")
    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "## Policy Applied",
            "",
            "- Only Chinese futures exchanges in the local standard code system are accepted: CFFEX, CZCE, DCE, GFEX, INE, SHFE.",
            "- A product must appear in both BigQuant `cn_future_basic_info` and `cn_future_static_data`.",
            "- Static-data `product_class` must be exactly `1` for the product to be treated as a plain futures product in this batch.",
            "- BigQuant `position_date_type` is mapped as `1 -> distinguish_today_yesterday`, `2 -> undistinguished`.",
            "- For non-versioned fields with multiple historical values, the generated candidate uses the mode on the latest available `trading_day`; the conflict is retained in `static_meta_multi_value_fields.csv` and requires confirmation.",
            "",
            "## Output Files",
            "",
            "- `candidate_static_meta.csv`",
            "- `static_meta_multi_value_fields.csv`",
            "- `rejected_product_info_codes.csv`",
            "- `yaml/*.yaml`",
            "",
        ]
    )
    (OUT_ROOT / "audit_report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> None:
    product_info = read_product_info()
    basic_info = read_basic_info()
    static_data = read_static_data()
    candidates, multi_values, rejected = build_candidates(product_info, basic_info, static_data)
    yaml_count = write_yaml(candidates)
    write_report(candidates, multi_values, rejected, yaml_count)
    print(f"StaticMeta candidates: {candidates[candidates['status'].isin(['ok', 'needs_review'])].shape[0]}")
    print(f"YAML files written: {yaml_count}")
    print(f"Multi-value findings: {multi_values.shape[0]}")
    print(f"Rejected product-info codes: {rejected.shape[0]}")
    print(f"Output: {OUT_ROOT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Generate TIER1 TransactionCostRule candidates from local raw snapshots.

The first rule of each product is backfilled to the product's first listed
trading date when earlier fee observations are unavailable. This is an explicit
weak assumption requested for the first ingestion pass and is written as a YAML
comment plus audit metadata.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd
import yaml


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
RAW_ROOT = ROOT / "db" / "rules_ingestion" / "data" / "raw" / "20260622"
STATIC_BATCH = ROOT / "db" / "rules_ingestion" / "data" / "derived" / "20260624" / "product_meta_static"
OUT_ROOT = ROOT / "db" / "rules_ingestion" / "data" / "derived" / "20260624" / "product_meta_transaction_cost"
YAML_DIR = OUT_ROOT / "yaml"

EXCHANGE_ALIASES = {
    "CFE": "CFFEX",
    "CFX": "CFFEX",
    "CFFEX": "CFFEX",
    "CZC": "CZCE",
    "ZCE": "CZCE",
    "CZCE": "CZCE",
    "DCE": "DCE",
    "GFE": "GFEX",
    "GFEX": "GFEX",
    "INE": "INE",
    "SHF": "SHFE",
    "SHFE": "SHFE",
}
BIGQUANT_COMMISSION_TYPE = {1: "flat", 2: "ratio"}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FeeTuple:
    commission_type: str
    open: float
    close_yesterday: float
    close_today: float

    def as_key(self) -> tuple[str, float, float, float]:
        return (
            self.commission_type,
            round(float(self.open), 12),
            round(float(self.close_yesterday), 12),
            round(float(self.close_today), 12),
        )


def normalize_product(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text.upper() if text else None


def normalize_exchange(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    return EXCHANGE_ALIASES.get(str(value).strip().upper())


def iso_from_yyyymmdd(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text or text.lower() in {"nat", "none", "nan"}:
        return None
    if len(text) >= 10 and text[4] == "-":
        return text[:10]
    text = text.split(".")[0]
    if len(text) != 8:
        return None
    return f"{text[:4]}-{text[4:6]}-{text[6:8]}"


def numeric(value: Any, default: float | None = None) -> float | None:
    out = pd.to_numeric(pd.Series([value]), errors="coerce").iloc[0]
    if pd.isna(out):
        return default
    return float(out)


def read_static_candidates() -> pd.DataFrame:
    path = STATIC_BATCH / "candidate_static_meta.csv"
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    return df[df["status"].isin(["ok", "needs_review"])].copy()


def read_product_list_dates() -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for path in sorted((RAW_ROOT / "tushare" / "fut_basic").glob("exchange=*.parquet")):
        df = pd.read_parquet(path, columns=["exchange", "fut_code", "list_date"])
        df["exchange_local"] = df["exchange"].map(normalize_exchange)
        df["product"] = df["fut_code"].map(normalize_product)
        df["list_date_iso"] = df["list_date"].map(iso_from_yyyymmdd)
        for (exchange, product), group in df.dropna(subset=["exchange_local", "product", "list_date_iso"]).groupby(
            ["exchange_local", "product"]
        ):
            rows.append(
                {
                    "exchange": exchange,
                    "product": product,
                    "source": "tushare.fut_basic",
                    "first_list_date": min(group["list_date_iso"]),
                }
            )

    for path in sorted((RAW_ROOT / "bigquant" / "cn_future_basic_info").glob("exchange=*.parquet")):
        df = pd.read_parquet(path, columns=["exchange", "product_code", "list_date"])
        df["exchange_local"] = df["exchange"].map(normalize_exchange)
        df["product"] = df["product_code"].map(normalize_product)
        df["list_date_iso"] = df["list_date"].map(iso_from_yyyymmdd)
        df = df[df["list_date_iso"].notna() & (df["list_date_iso"] > "1980-01-01")]
        for (exchange, product), group in df.dropna(subset=["exchange_local", "product"]).groupby(
            ["exchange_local", "product"]
        ):
            rows.append(
                {
                    "exchange": exchange,
                    "product": product,
                    "source": "bigquant.cn_future_basic_info",
                    "first_list_date": min(group["list_date_iso"]),
                }
            )

    all_dates = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if all_dates.empty:
        return all_dates
    priority = {"tushare.fut_basic": 0, "bigquant.cn_future_basic_info": 1}
    all_dates["source_priority"] = all_dates["source"].map(priority)
    all_dates = all_dates.sort_values(["exchange", "product", "source_priority", "first_list_date"])
    return all_dates.groupby(["exchange", "product"], as_index=False).first()[
        ["exchange", "product", "first_list_date", "source"]
    ]


def read_bigquant_current() -> pd.DataFrame:
    path = RAW_ROOT / "bigquant" / "cn_future_product_info" / "full.parquet"
    df = pd.read_parquet(path)
    df["exchange"] = df["exchange"].map(normalize_exchange)
    df["product"] = df["code"].map(normalize_product)
    df["bq_commission_type"] = pd.to_numeric(df["commission_type"], errors="coerce").map(
        lambda x: BIGQUANT_COMMISSION_TYPE.get(int(x)) if pd.notna(x) else None
    )
    return df[
        [
            "exchange",
            "product",
            "bq_commission_type",
            "commission_open",
            "commission_yesterday",
            "commission_today",
        ]
    ].dropna(subset=["exchange", "product"])


def settle_paths() -> dict[tuple[str, str], Path]:
    paths: dict[tuple[str, str], Path] = {}
    for path in sorted((RAW_ROOT / "tushare" / "fut_settle").glob("exchange=*/product=*.parquet")):
        exchange = normalize_exchange(path.parent.name.split("=", 1)[1])
        product = normalize_product(path.stem.split("=", 1)[1] if "=" in path.stem else path.stem)
        if exchange and product:
            paths[(exchange, product)] = path
    return paths


def normalize_rate(value: float) -> float:
    if value >= 0.001:
        return value / 1000.0
    return value


def fee_tuple_from_row(row: Any, bq_commission_type: str | None = None) -> FeeTuple:
    rate = numeric(row.trading_fee_rate, 0.0) or 0.0
    fee = numeric(row.trading_fee, 0.0) or 0.0
    offset_today = numeric(row.offset_today_fee, None)
    if rate > 0:
        commission_type = "ratio"
        open_fee = normalize_rate(rate)
    elif bq_commission_type == "ratio":
        commission_type = "ratio"
        open_fee = fee / 10000.0 if fee >= 0.001 else fee
    else:
        commission_type = "flat"
        open_fee = fee
    close_yesterday = open_fee
    close_today = open_fee if offset_today is None else offset_today
    return FeeTuple(
        commission_type=commission_type,
        open=float(open_fee),
        close_yesterday=float(close_yesterday),
        close_today=float(close_today),
    )


def instrument_to_local(ts_code: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(ts_code, str) or "." not in ts_code:
        return str(ts_code).upper()
    body, suffix = ts_code.split(".", 1)
    exchange = normalize_exchange(suffix) or suffix.upper()
    return f"{body.upper()}.{exchange}"


def build_product_history(
    exchange: str,
    product: str,
    settle_path: Path,
    first_list_date: str | None,
    bq_commission_type: str | None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
    df = pd.read_parquet(settle_path)
    if df.empty:
        return [], [], {"status": "no_settle_rows"}

    df["trade_date_iso"] = df["trade_date"].map(iso_from_yyyymmdd)
    df = df.dropna(subset=["trade_date_iso"]).copy()
    for col in ["trading_fee_rate", "trading_fee", "offset_today_fee"]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")
    df["has_open_fee_evidence"] = (df["trading_fee_rate"].fillna(0.0) > 0) | (df["trading_fee"].fillna(0.0) > 0)
    rows_without_open_fee_evidence = int((~df["has_open_fee_evidence"]).sum())
    df = df[df["has_open_fee_evidence"]].copy()
    if df.empty:
        return [], [], {
            "status": "no_fee_evidence_rows",
            "rows_without_open_fee_evidence": rows_without_open_fee_evidence,
        }
    df["fee_key"] = [fee_tuple_from_row(row, bq_commission_type).as_key() for row in df.itertuples(index=False)]
    df["instrument_local"] = df["ts_code"].map(instrument_to_local)

    daily_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    conflict_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for trade_date, group in df.groupby("trade_date_iso"):
        keys = sorted(set(group["fee_key"]))
        if len(keys) == 1:
            key = keys[0]
            daily_rows.append(
                {
                    "trade_date": trade_date,
                    "commission_type": key[0],
                    "open": key[1],
                    "close_yesterday": key[2],
                    "close_today": key[3],
                    "instrument_count": int(group["instrument_local"].nunique(dropna=True)),
                    "row_count": int(len(group)),
                }
            )
        else:
            for key, sub in group.groupby("fee_key"):
                conflict_rows.append(
                    {
                        "exchange": exchange,
                        "product": product,
                        "trade_date": trade_date,
                        "commission_type": key[0],
                        "open": key[1],
                        "close_yesterday": key[2],
                        "close_today": key[3],
                        "instrument_count": int(sub["instrument_local"].nunique(dropna=True)),
                        "sample_instruments": "|".join(sorted(sub["instrument_local"].dropna().unique())[:20]),
                    }
                )

    if not daily_rows:
        return [], conflict_rows, {
            "status": "no_product_level_compressible_dates",
            "earliest_observed_fee_date": min(df["trade_date_iso"]) if not df.empty else None,
            "latest_observed_fee_date": max(df["trade_date_iso"]) if not df.empty else None,
            "conflict_days": len(set(r["trade_date"] for r in conflict_rows)),
        }

    daily = pd.DataFrame(daily_rows).sort_values("trade_date")
    rules: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    last_key: tuple[str, float, float, float] | None = None
    earliest_product_level_date = str(daily.iloc[0]["trade_date"])
    effective_start = first_list_date or earliest_product_level_date
    for row in daily.itertuples(index=False):
        key = (
            row.commission_type,
            float(row.open),
            float(row.close_yesterday),
            float(row.close_today),
        )
        if last_key == key:
            continue
        effective_date = effective_start if not rules else row.trade_date
        rules.append(
            {
                "effective_date": effective_date,
                "commission_type": row.commission_type,
                "open": float(row.open),
                "close_yesterday": float(row.close_yesterday),
                "close_today": float(row.close_today),
                "scope": [],
                "condition": None,
                "observed_trade_date": row.trade_date,
                "is_backfilled_first_rule": len(rules) == 0 and effective_date != row.trade_date,
            }
        )
        last_key = key

    metadata = {
        "status": "ok",
        "first_list_date": first_list_date,
        "earliest_observed_fee_date": min(df["trade_date_iso"]),
        "earliest_product_level_fee_date": earliest_product_level_date,
        "latest_observed_fee_date": max(df["trade_date_iso"]),
        "observed_days": int(df["trade_date_iso"].nunique()),
        "product_level_days": int(daily.shape[0]),
        "conflict_days": len(set(r["trade_date"] for r in conflict_rows)),
        "rules": len(rules),
        "instruments": int(df["instrument_local"].nunique(dropna=True)),
        "rows_without_open_fee_evidence": rows_without_open_fee_evidence,
    }
    return rules, conflict_rows, metadata


def float_text(value: float) -> str:
    return f"{float(value):.12g}"


def write_product_yaml(static_payload: dict[str, Any], rules: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    YAML_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    product = static_payload["product"]
    lines = [
        f"product: {product}",
        f"exchange: {static_payload['exchange']}",
        f"name: {static_payload['name']}",
        f"position_date_type: {static_payload['position_date_type']}",
        f"max_margin_side_algorithm: {str(bool(static_payload['max_margin_side_algorithm'])).lower()}",
        f"combination_type: {int(static_payload['combination_type'])}",
        "transaction_cost_history:",
    ]
    for index, rule in enumerate(rules):
        lines.append("  -")
        if index == 0:
            lines.append(
                f"    effective_date: '{rule['effective_date']}'  # inferred by backfilling from earliest "
                f"product-level observed fee date {rule['observed_trade_date']}; very weak assumption"
            )
        else:
            lines.append(f"    effective_date: '{rule['effective_date']}'")
        lines.extend(
            [
                f"    commission_type: {rule['commission_type']}",
                f"    open: {float_text(rule['open'])}",
                f"    close_yesterday: {float_text(rule['close_yesterday'])}",
                f"    close_today: {float_text(rule['close_today'])}",
                "    scope: []",
                "    condition: null",
            ]
        )
    (YAML_DIR / f"{product}.yaml").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def compare_bigquant(latest_rule: dict[str, Any], bq_row: pd.Series | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if bq_row is None:
        return {
            "bq_available": False,
            "bq_type_match": None,
            "bq_open_match": None,
            "bq_yesterday_match": None,
            "bq_today_match": None,
        }

    def close(a: Any, b: Any) -> bool | None:
        aa = numeric(a, None)
        bb = numeric(b, None)
        if aa is None or bb is None:
            return None
        return abs(aa - bb) <= max(1e-12, abs(bb) * 1e-8)

    return {
        "bq_available": True,
        "bq_type": bq_row.get("bq_commission_type"),
        "bq_open": bq_row.get("commission_open"),
        "bq_yesterday": bq_row.get("commission_yesterday"),
        "bq_today": bq_row.get("commission_today"),
        "bq_type_match": latest_rule["commission_type"] == bq_row.get("bq_commission_type"),
        "bq_open_match": close(latest_rule["open"], bq_row.get("commission_open")),
        "bq_yesterday_match": close(latest_rule["close_yesterday"], bq_row.get("commission_yesterday")),
        "bq_today_match": close(latest_rule["close_today"], bq_row.get("commission_today")),
    }


def main() -> None:
    OUT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if YAML_DIR.exists():
        for old_yaml in YAML_DIR.glob("*.yaml"):
            old_yaml.unlink()
    candidates = read_static_candidates()
    list_dates = read_product_list_dates()
    bq_current = read_bigquant_current()
    paths = settle_paths()

    list_date_map = {
        (row.exchange, row.product): row.first_list_date for row in list_dates.itertuples(index=False)
    }
    bq_map = {
        (row.exchange, row.product): row
        for row in bq_current.dropna(subset=["exchange", "product"]).itertuples(index=False)
    }

    summary_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    rule_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    all_conflicts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    validation_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for static in candidates.sort_values(["exchange", "product"]).itertuples(index=False):
        key = (static.exchange, static.product)
        settle_path = paths.get(key)
        if settle_path is None:
            summary_rows.append(
                {
                    "exchange": static.exchange,
                    "product": static.product,
                    "status": "missing_fut_settle",
                    "first_list_date": list_date_map.get(key),
                    "rules": 0,
                }
            )
            continue

        bq_row = bq_map.get(key)
        bq_type = bq_row.bq_commission_type if bq_row is not None else None
        rules, conflicts, metadata = build_product_history(
            static.exchange, static.product, settle_path, list_date_map.get(key), bq_type
        )
        all_conflicts.extend(conflicts)
        summary = {"exchange": static.exchange, "product": static.product, **metadata}
        summary_rows.append(summary)
        if not rules:
            continue

        static_payload = {
            "product": static.product,
            "exchange": static.exchange,
            "name": static.name,
            "position_date_type": static.position_date_type,
            "max_margin_side_algorithm": static.max_margin_side_algorithm,
            "combination_type": static.combination_type,
        }
        write_product_yaml(static_payload, rules)
        for idx, rule in enumerate(rules):
            rule_rows.append(
                {
                    "exchange": static.exchange,
                    "product": static.product,
                    "rule_index": idx,
                    **rule,
                }
            )
        validation_rows.append(
            {
                "exchange": static.exchange,
                "product": static.product,
                "latest_rule_effective_date": rules[-1]["effective_date"],
                "latest_rule_observed_trade_date": rules[-1]["observed_trade_date"],
                "latest_commission_type": rules[-1]["commission_type"],
                "latest_open": rules[-1]["open"],
                "latest_close_yesterday": rules[-1]["close_yesterday"],
                "latest_close_today": rules[-1]["close_today"],
                **compare_bigquant(rules[-1], pd.Series(bq_row._asdict()) if bq_row is not None else None),
            }
        )

    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
    rules_df = pd.DataFrame(rule_rows)
    conflicts_df = pd.DataFrame(all_conflicts)
    validation_df = pd.DataFrame(validation_rows)
    summary_df.to_csv(OUT_ROOT / "transaction_cost_product_summary.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    rules_df.to_csv(OUT_ROOT / "transaction_cost_rules.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    conflicts_df.to_csv(OUT_ROOT / "transaction_cost_conflicts.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
    validation_df.to_csv(OUT_ROOT / "transaction_cost_bigquant_current_validation.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    yaml_count = len(list(YAML_DIR.glob("*.yaml"))) if YAML_DIR.exists() else 0
    ok_products = int((summary_df["status"] == "ok").sum()) if "status" in summary_df else 0
    missing = int((summary_df["status"] == "missing_fut_settle").sum()) if "status" in summary_df else 0
    conflict_products = int(conflicts_df[["exchange", "product"]].drop_duplicates().shape[0]) if not conflicts_df.empty else 0
    lines = [
        "# TransactionCostRule Ingestion Audit",
        "",
        "- Batch: 20260624",
        "- Raw snapshot: `db/rules_ingestion/data/raw/20260622`",
        "- Source of generated rules: Tushare `fut_settle`",
        "- BigQuant `cn_future_product_info` is used only for current-value validation.",
        f"- Target products from StaticMeta candidates: {len(candidates)}",
        f"- Products with generated candidate histories: {ok_products}",
        f"- Candidate YAML files: {yaml_count}",
        f"- Products missing local `fut_settle` data: {missing}",
        f"- Products with at least one same-day tuple conflict: {conflict_products}",
        f"- Generated rule rows: {len(rules_df)}",
        "",
        "## Assumptions",
        "",
        "- The first generated fee rule is backfilled to the product's first listed trading date when earlier fee observations are unavailable.",
        "- The YAML comment on the first `effective_date` records the earliest product-level observed fee date and labels the rule as a very weak assumption.",
        "- `trading_fee_rate > 0` maps to `commission_type: ratio`; Tushare rate-like values such as `0.1` are normalized to local decimal ratios such as `0.0001`.",
        "- If BigQuant current product metadata says a product is ratio-based but Tushare reports the value in `trading_fee`, the value is interpreted as per-ten-thousand and divided by 10000.",
        "- Rows where both `trading_fee_rate` and `trading_fee` are zero are treated as missing open-fee evidence, not as real zero-fee rules.",
        "- `close_yesterday` is assumed equal to `open` because Tushare `fut_settle` does not provide a separate close-yesterday fee field.",
        "- Missing `offset_today_fee` is filled from `open`; non-missing `offset_today_fee` is used as `close_today`.",
        "- `scope` is written as `[]` for generated product-level rules; same-day contract-level tuple conflicts are reported and not compressed into product-level YAML.",
        "- `condition` defaults to `null`.",
        "",
        "## Output Files",
        "",
        "- `transaction_cost_product_summary.csv`",
        "- `transaction_cost_rules.csv`",
        "- `transaction_cost_conflicts.csv`",
        "- `transaction_cost_bigquant_current_validation.csv`",
        "- `yaml/*.yaml`",
        "",
    ]
    (OUT_ROOT / "audit_report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"Target products: {len(candidates)}")
    print(f"Generated histories: {ok_products}")
    print(f"YAML files written: {yaml_count}")
    print(f"Missing fut_settle products: {missing}")
    print(f"Conflict products: {conflict_products}")
    print(f"Rule rows: {len(rules_df)}")
    print(f"Output: {OUT_ROOT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# 期货量化交易回测引擎数据字段与工业级需求分析

为了让您的回测引擎对标**百亿私募实盘标准**，在模拟数据和系统部件设计时，不能仅做简单的“多空盈亏统计”。工业级回测引擎需要高精度地模拟**资金占用、执行限制、合规风控以及交易所特有的结算机制**。

以下是针对您列出的 17 个关键数据字段，结合量化回测系统各部件（撮合引擎、资金与保证金引擎、风控与合规引擎、手续费引擎）的深度解析。

---

## 一、 核心字段详解与组件映射

### 1. 价格与订单限制类（撮合引擎 & 风控引擎）

#### 涨跌停价 (Limit Up/Down Price)
* **业务含义**：交易所规定的当日最高和最低交易价格。
* **回测组件**：**风控引擎 (Risk Engine)** & **撮合引擎 (Matching Engine)**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * **委托拦截**：在风控环节，任何超出涨跌停区间的委托（例如在跌停板下方挂单买入，或在涨停板上方挂单卖出）都会被直接拒单（Rejected by Gateway）。
  * **单边市撮合（板上交易模拟）**：当价格触及涨跌停价时，市场通常会出现“单边市”（涨停时只有买单排队，无卖单；跌停时只有卖单排队，无买单）。
    * *Level 1 Tick 撮合*：若 Bid1 价格等于跌停价且 Bid1 Volume 为 0（说明卖单挂在跌停板，没有买单），此时做多是无法立刻成交的。回测引擎必须模拟队列（Queue）排队或只允许反向交易（只能卖，不能买）。
    * *Bar 级别撮合*：若 Bar 的 High 等于涨停价或 Low 等于跌停价，不能简单按 High/Low 价全额撮合成交，必须判断是否“封板”（即盘中是否有持续无量封板状态）。如果是封板，策略的入场单通常无法成交，否则会严重高估策略收益。

#### 市价单/限价单 最大/最小下单量 (Max/Min Order Volumes)
* **业务含义**：单笔委托能发送的最大和最小合约手数。例如股指期货（CFFEX）限价单单笔最大 200 手，市价单单笔最大 50 手；商品期货通常为几百手至上千手。最小下单量通常为 1 手。
* **回测组件**：**风控引擎 (Risk Engine) / 执行算法 (Execution Algos)**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * **合规拦截**：实盘交易中，如果策略发送了单笔 300 手的股指限价单，API 会直接报错拒单。回测系统也必须在风控部件拦截此类订单，否则回测出的交易曲线是无法在实盘中执行的。
  * **拆单模拟（Slicing/Iceberg）**：百亿私募在实盘中通常拥有大资金，单次信号触发的下单量可能远超单笔最大限制。在回测中，执行算法组件必须能够模拟**自动拆单**（例如将 500 手拆成 3 笔发送），并叠加由于拆单带来的**时间延迟和市场冲击（Slippage & Market Impact）**。

#### 价格档位 (Price Level / Tick Size)
* **业务含义**：最小变动价位（例如螺纹钢为 1 元/吨，黄金为 0.02 元/克）。
* **回测组件**：**风控引擎 & 撮合引擎**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * **价格对齐校验**：委托价格必须是价格档位的整数倍（即 `(Price - RefPrice) % TickSize == 0`）。如果不符，交易所会废单。回测引擎需要在委托进入撮合前进行价格归整（Rounding）或直接废单拦截。
  * **Level 1 Tick 撮合填充**：使用 Bid1/Ask1 数据时，价格档位限制了挂单的密集度。在计算点差滑点时，最小变动价位是滑点单位计算的基准。

---

### 2. 资金、保证金与资产组合类（资金与保证金引擎）

这是对标“百亿私募实盘标准”最核心、最复杂的模块。百亿私募非常看重**资金利用率（Capital Efficiency）**，因此对保证金的模拟必须做到极致。

#### 多头保证金率 / 空头保证金率 (Long/Short Margin Rate)
* **业务含义**：开仓一手合约所需缴纳的资金占合约总价值的比例。
* **回测组件**：**资金与保证金引擎 (Account & Margin Engine)**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * **动态保证金率（极其重要）**：保证金率在回测中**绝对不能设为常数**。
    1. **临近交割月提高**：随着合约靠近交割期，交易所会逐步提高保证金率（如从 8% 提升至 15%、20% 甚至 50%）。
    2. **长假效应**：国庆节、春节等长假前，交易所和期货公司会统一上调保证金率（防范国际市场跳空风险）。
    3. **单边市/连续涨跌停**：当出现连续板时，交易所会实行风险控制，临时提高保证金率。
  * **期货公司加收 (Broker Margin)**：实盘中私募拿到的是“期货公司保证金率”，通常在交易所基准上加收固定比例（例如交易所 8%，期货公司加收 2%，实际为 10%）。回测引擎必须支持在交易所保证金数据上加上一个 `Broker_Surcharge_Rate`。
  * **资金冻结计算**：
    $$\text{冻结资金} = \text{持仓价值} \times \text{保证金率} + \text{挂单未成交部分冻结}$$
    回测中必须实时计算可用资金（`Free Margin`），若 `Free Margin < 0`，需模拟实盘的**强平风控**。

#### 是否使用大额单边保证金算法 (Large Margin Single-Side / SPBM)
* **业务含义**：国内大商所、郑商所实行的**单向大额保证金**政策，以及中金所逐步推行的 **SPBM (Securities & Futures Portfolio Margin)** 组合保证金系统。
* **回测组件**：**资金与保证金引擎 (Account & Margin Engine)**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * **单边保证金 (Same-Product Offset)**：若策略同时持有同一品种不同合约的多头和空头（例如：多 RB2610 100手，空 RB2612 80手），交易所仅收取大额单边（即 100 手多头）的保证金，而不是 180 手的双边保证金。
  * **SPBM 跨品种/跨期组合**：在股指期货与股指期权、或特定关联商品（如煤焦钢组合）之间，SPBM 算法通过评估组合的净风险（Net Risk）来大幅降低保证金占用。
  * **百亿私募的痛点**：对于多因子/套利策略，如果回测引擎使用简单的“双边保证金计算”，会**严重低估可用资金，降低回测中的实际杠杆率和年化收益率**，甚至导致不该发生的强平。因此，回测引擎必须在每日结算（Settlement）和盘中计算时，实现大额单边和组合保证金的计算逻辑。

#### 组合类型 (Combination Type)
* **业务含义**：定义哪些合约可以构成交易所认可的套利组合（如跨期套利组合、跨品种套利组合）。
* **回测组件**：**资金与保证金引擎**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * 该字段指示了合约在结算时是否能够申请“套利保证金优惠”。回测系统需要根据组合类型，在每日盘后结算时，将符合条件的持仓对冲，释放多余的保证金。

#### 持仓类型 & 持仓日期类型 (Position Type & Position Date Type)
* **业务含义**：
  * *持仓类型*：净持仓（Net）与双向持仓（Gross）。国内期货全为双向持仓（多空并存）。
  * *持仓日期类型*：今仓（Today's Position）与昨仓（Yesterday's Position）。
* **回测组件**：**持仓引擎 (Position Manager) & 手续费引擎 (Fee Engine)**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * **平今/平昨差异（极关键）**：上海期货交易所（SHFE）和能源交易中心（INE）严格区分平今和平昨。
    * 很多品种平今仓的手续费是平昨仓的数倍（即惩罚性平今费率，如某时期甲醇、纯碱平今费率极高）。
    * 策略在发出平仓信号时，必须明确是平今（CloseToday）还是平昨（CloseYesterday）。回测引擎的手续费计算模块必须追踪持仓的“日期类型”，准确计算手续费。否则，高频/日内策略的回测净值会因为手续费计算偏差而完全失真。

---

### 3. 合约生命周期与交割风险类（风控引擎 & 策略路由）

#### 合约到期日、开始交割日、最后交割日 (Expiration & Delivery Dates)
* **业务含义**：合约停止交易并进入交割流程的关键时间节点。
* **回测组件**：**风控引擎 (Risk Engine) & 策略滚动逻辑 (Roll Logic)**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * **限仓与交割禁令（百亿私募核心红线）**：
    * **商品期货非法人户无法交割**：国内商品期货规定，普通机构投资者（私募产品通常属于“非法人户”）和个人投资者**不允许进入交割月**，或者持仓不能带入交割月临近交易日。
    * **持仓梯度限仓**：临近交割月时，交易所对单个账户的最大持仓量有极严格的梯度限制（如从 1000 手限制到 100 手，最后限制为 0 手）。
  * **回测自动强平/强制换月**：风控引擎必须在临近交割日/开始交割日前，强制将策略的持仓平仓或提醒换月。如果在回测中将商品期货持仓持有到了“最后交割日”之后，说明回测逻辑出现了严重漏洞。

#### 合约生命周期状态 / 当前交易状态 (Lifecycle & Trading Status)
* **业务含义**：
  * *生命周期状态*：上市（Listed）、退市（Delisted）、暂停（Suspended）。
  * *当前交易状态*：集合竞价（Auction）、连续交易（Continuous）、暂停交易（Halt）。
* **回测组件**：**策略路由器 (Strategy Router) & 撮合引擎**
* **实盘标准与回测设计**：
  * **防止“未来函数”与无效交易**：
    * 在退市或暂停交易状态下，撮合引擎必须拒单。
    * 在集合竞价期间（如 08:55 - 09:00），交易指令只能以集合竞价撮合机制（单一定价）处理，不能按连续交易（Level 1 盘口直接对冲）撮合。
    * 换月逻辑必须依赖“生命周期状态”——不能在合约上市前或退市后读取其行情或对其下单。

---

## 二、 工业级回测引擎架构与数据字段交互图

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph StrategyExecution ["策略与执行层 (Strategy & Execution)"]
        Strat["策略信号"] -->|发送委托 Order| Exec["执行与拆单算法"]
        Exec -->|Slices/Iceberg| Risk["风控与合规引擎"]
    end

    subgraph CoreBacktesting ["核心回测部件 (Core Backtesting Components)"]
        Risk -->|检查涨跌停/委托量上限/交割月限制| Match["撮合引擎"]
        Match -->|Level 1 Tick & Bar 撮合| Fill["成交回报 Fill"]
        Fill -->|更新持仓| Pos["持仓管理器"]
        Pos -->|今昨仓区分| Fee["手续费引擎"]
        Pos -->|单边/组合持仓| Margin["资金与保证金引擎"]
    end

    subgraph DataProvider ["数据层 (Data Provider)"]
        Static["cn_future_static_data"] -->|输入保证金率/最大最小下单量| Margin
        Static -->|输入涨跌停价/状态| Risk
        Static -->|价格档位/状态| Match
        Basic["cn_future_basic_info"] -->|交割日/到期日| Risk
    end

    Pos -.->|反馈持仓状况| Strat
    Margin -.->|可用资金 Free Margin| Risk
```

---

## 三、 给您的下一步开发建议

1. **统一代码大小写规范**：
   * 针对您在笔记中提到的“大小写区分”问题：工业级系统内部推荐**统一转换为大写**（如在大连商品交易所的 `lh` 转换为 `LH`），或者使用统一的规范化函数（Normalizer）。这能避免在多因子合并或数据库 Join 时因为大小写不匹配导致的数据丢失。
2. **细化手续费与今昨仓追踪**：
   * 建议在您的持仓数据结构（`Position` class）中，不仅记录 `volume`，还要拆分为 `today_volume` 和 `yesterday_volume`。
   * 编写手续费计算模块时，必须接入“平今费率”和“平昨费率”，并优先平扣不同类型的持仓（通常遵循“平今优先”或策略指定原则）。
3. **分阶段实现保证金引擎**：
   * **第一阶段**：实现基础的多空双边保证金计算（用合约当前结算价/收盘价 * 保证金率 * 乘数）。
   * **第二阶段**：引入“单向大额保证金算法”，针对同一品种的多空持仓进行对冲。这能让您的策略回测资金占用与实盘私募账户完全对齐。

# SimulationFeed 设计规划

**模块定位**：Data Engine 面向回测引擎（Execution 模块）的唯一实盘流式接口，负责按时间顺序分发 tick 数据，并在换月期同时下发新旧主力合约的快照。

---

## 一、核心数据结构

### ContractTick
单个合约的单笔 tick 数据。

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ContractTick:
    """
    单个合约的单笔 tick 数据。

    Parameters
    ----------
    contract : str
        合约代码，例如 "RB2505"。
    timestamp : pd.Timestamp
        tick 的日历时间戳。
    last : float
        最新价。
    bid : float
        买一价。
    ask : float
        卖一价。
    volume : int
        成交量。
    open_interest : float
        持仓量。
    """
    contract: str
    timestamp: pd.Timestamp
    last: float
    bid: float
    ask: float
    volume: int
    open_interest: float
```

### MarketSnapshot
某一时刻向回测引擎下发的完整市场快照，包含新旧主力合约的状态。

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MarketSnapshot:
    """
    某一时刻的市场快照，向回测引擎下发。

    Parameters
    ----------
    timestamp : pd.Timestamp
        快照的日历时间戳，严格单调递增。
    trading_date : datetime.date
        该快照归属的 Trading Date。
    dominant : ContractTick
        当前主力合约的 tick（ZOH 填充）。
    outgoing : ContractTick or None
        换月期间的旧主力合约 tick（ZOH 填充）。
        非换月期为 None。
    is_roll_period : bool
        是否处于换月期。
    """
    timestamp: pd.Timestamp
    trading_date: datetime.date
    dominant: ContractTick
    outgoing: ContractTick | None
    is_roll_period: bool
```

---

## 二、核心算法：Min-Heap 多流调度 + ZOH

### 算法概述

```
输入：
  - 旧主力合约的 tick Generator（换月期存在）
  - 新主力合约的 tick Generator

核心循环：
  1. 将两个 Generator 的当前头部 tick 压入 Min-Heap
     排序键：(timestamp, priority)
     priority：旧主力 = 0，新主力 = 1（同时刻时旧主力优先弹出）

  2. 弹出时间戳最小的 tick，暂存

  3. 检查堆顶：若下一个 tick 时间戳与当前相同，继续弹出并暂存
     （合并同一时刻的多个 tick，避免重复下发同一时刻的快照）

  4. ZOH 填充：
     对于本时刻未产生新 tick 的合约，保留其上一笔快照数据

  5. 组装 MarketSnapshot，下发给回测引擎

  6. 对已弹出的每个 Generator，推进一步（取下一个 tick 压回堆）

  7. 重复，直到堆为空
```

### 伪代码

```python
import heapq
from typing import Generator

def _stream(
    self,
    dominant_gen: Generator[ContractTick, None, None],
    outgoing_gen: Generator[ContractTick, None, None] | None,
    is_roll_period: bool,
) -> Generator[MarketSnapshot, None, None]:

    heap = []
    zoh: dict[str, ContractTick] = {}  # 各合约的 ZOH 状态

    # 初始化堆：将两个 Generator 的第一个 tick 压入
    # 堆元素：(timestamp, priority, contract_label, tick)
    # priority：旧主力 = 0，新主力 = 1
    def push_next(gen, priority, label):
        try:
            tick = next(gen)
            heapq.heappush(heap, (tick.timestamp, priority, label, tick, gen))
        except StopIteration:
            pass  # Generator 耗尽，不压入

    push_next(dominant_gen, priority=1, label="dominant")
    if outgoing_gen:
        push_next(outgoing_gen, priority=0, label="outgoing")

    while heap:
        # 弹出最小时间戳的 tick
        ts, _, label, tick, gen = heapq.heappop(heap)
        batch = {label: tick}

        # 检查同一时刻是否有另一合约的 tick，合并
        while heap and heap[0][0] == ts:
            _, _, label2, tick2, gen2 = heapq.heappop(heap)
            batch[label2] = tick2
            push_next(gen2, ...)  # 推进该 Generator

        # ZOH 更新
        zoh.update(batch)

        # 组装快照
        snapshot = MarketSnapshot(
            timestamp=ts,
            trading_date=self._calendar.get_trading_date(ts),
            dominant=zoh["dominant"],
            outgoing=zoh.get("outgoing"),
            is_roll_period=is_roll_period,
        )

        yield snapshot

        # 推进本次弹出的 Generator
        push_next(gen, ...)
```

---

## 三、需要注意的细节

1. **双流边界的精确定义**
   换月日的双流应从该 Trading Session 的第一个 tick 开始，即换月日夜盘的第一个 tick（日历日为换月日前一天）。回测引擎需要在换月日的完整价格信息基础上做换仓决策，因此不能推迟到日盘才开始双流。

2. **同一时刻双 tick 的合并逻辑**
   当两个合约在同一时间戳都有 tick 时，必须合并成一个 `MarketSnapshot` 一次性下发，而不是分两次下发。分两次下发会导致回测引擎在同一时刻收到两个快照，破坏时间单调性语义。

3. **时间戳严格单调递增**
   `MarketSnapshot` 的 `timestamp` 必须严格单调递增，绝对不允许出现 T+1 的快照先于 T 的快照下发。Min-Heap 在单交易日内自动保证这一点，但需要额外注意跨交易日边界（夜盘第一个 tick 的日历时间戳）不发生跳变或乱序。

4. **旧主力 Generator 耗尽后的优雅降级**
   换月结束后旧主力的 Generator 会自然耗尽（`StopIteration`）。此时应将其从堆中移除，后续快照的 `outgoing` 字段置为 `None`，`is_roll_period` 置为 `False`，切换回单流模式，不抛出异常。

5. **ZOH 的初始状态处理**
   在第一个 tick 到达之前，ZOH 状态为空。需要定义初始快照的处理策略：
   - 选项 A：在第一个 tick 到达之前不下发任何快照（推荐）
   - 选项 B：用前一交易日的收盘价初始化 ZOH
   
   选项 A 更简单，回测引擎应能处理"数据从第一个 tick 开始"的语义。

6. **Trading Date 标签的正确映射**
   每个 `MarketSnapshot` 需要附上正确的 `trading_date`。若有需要，应通过 `TradingCalendar.get_trading_date(calendar_timestamp)` 转换。夜盘 tick 的日历时间戳属于前一自然日，但 `trading_date` 应归属下一个交易日，此处必须经过 `TradingCalendar` 转换，不能直接用 `timestamp.date()`。

---

## 四、SimulationFeed 类接口设计

```python
class SimulationFeed:
    """
    回测事件分发器，Data Engine 面向回测引擎的唯一流式接口。

    按时间顺序分发 MarketSnapshot，换月期同时下发新旧主力合约数据。

    Parameters
    ----------
    product : str
        期货品种代码，例如 "RB"。
    calendar : TradingCalendar
        交易日历，用于 Trading Date 映射和交易时段过滤。
    bar_loader : BarLoader
        底层 tick/bar 数据读取器。
    contract_manager : ContinuousContractManager
        换月总表管理器，提供每日主力合约和换月信息。

    Methods
    -------
    stream(start_date, end_date)
        返回指定交易日范围内的 MarketSnapshot Generator。
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        product: str,
        calendar: TradingCalendar,
        bar_loader: BarLoader,
        contract_manager: ContinuousContractManager,
    ): ...

    def stream(
        self,
        start_date: datetime.date,
        end_date: datetime.date,
    ) -> Generator[MarketSnapshot, None, None]:
        """
        按时间顺序下发 MarketSnapshot。

        Parameters
        ----------
        start_date : datetime.date
            起始交易日（Trading Date，含）。
        end_date : datetime.date
            结束交易日（Trading Date，含）。

        Yields
        ------
        MarketSnapshot
            包含当前时刻所有主力合约状态的市场快照，
            timestamp 严格单调递增。
        """
        ...
```

---

## 五、文件位置

```
data/
└── feed/
    ├── feed.py          # ResearchFeed（已有）
    ├── aggregator.py    # BarAggregator（已有）
    └── simulation.py    # SimulationFeed ← 新建
```

`SimulationFeed` 与 `ResearchFeed` 同属 `feed/` 子模块，共享 `BarLoader`、`TradingCalendar` 等基础设施依赖，通过 `factory.py` 组装后由 `facade.py` 对外暴露。

from __future__ import annotations

from itertools import count

from account.models import Fill
from backtester.models import BarMarketEvent
from executor.commission import CommissionModel, FixedPerContractCommissionModel
from executor.slippage import FixedSlippageModel
from portfolio.models import Order


class NextBarOpenExecutionModel:
    """市价单在下一根 Bar 开盘，以开盘价加上手续费和滑点，做全部成交。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        slippage_model: FixedSlippageModel | None = None,
        commission_model: CommissionModel | None = None,
    ):
        self.slippage_model = slippage_model or FixedSlippageModel()
        self.commission_model = commission_model or FixedPerContractCommissionModel()
        self._fill_seq = count(1)

    def execute(self, order: Order, bar: BarMarketEvent) -> Fill:
        slippage = self.slippage_model.calculate(order.side, bar.raw_open)
        if order.side == "BUY":
            price = bar.raw_open + slippage
        else:
            price = bar.raw_open - slippage
        commission = self.commission_model.calculate(
            contract=order.contract,
            side=order.side,
            quantity=order.quantity,
            price=price,
        )
        return Fill(
            fill_id=f"F{next(self._fill_seq):08d}",
            order_id=order.order_id,
            product=order.product,
            contract=order.contract,
            side=order.side,
            quantity=order.quantity,
            price=price,
            timestamp=bar.timestamp,
            commission=commission,
        )

    def execute_pending_orders(
        self,
        pending_orders: list[Order],
        bar: BarMarketEvent,
    ) -> list[Fill]:
        return [self.execute(order, bar) for order in pending_orders]

from __future__ import annotations

from itertools import count

from account.account import Account
from backtester.models import BarMarketEvent
from portfolio.models import Order, TargetPosition


class OrderManager:
    """根据目标仓位和账户实际仓位生成市价订单。"""

    def __init__(self):
        self._order_seq = count(1)

    def create_orders(
        self,
        target: TargetPosition,
        account: Account,
        market: BarMarketEvent,
    ) -> list[Order]:
        """
        根据目标仓位和账户现有仓位（差异）生成新订单：
        
        * 换月期：先平掉旧主力持仓，再在新主力上根据目标仓位和账户现有仓位差异做开仓。
        
        * 非换月期：根据目标仓位和账户现有仓位差异做开仓。
        """
        product = target.product
        market_contract = market.contract
        orders: list[Order] = []

        # 最小换月：先把同品种非当前主力的持仓平掉。
        for pos in account.positions_for_product(product):
            if pos.contract == market_contract:
                continue
            side = "SELL" if pos.quantity > 0 else "BUY"
            orders.append(
                self._new_order(
                    product=product,
                    contract=pos.contract,
                    side=side,
                    quantity=abs(pos.quantity),
                    created_at=market.timestamp,
                )
            )

        current_market_qty = account.get_position(market_contract).quantity if account.get_position(market_contract) else 0
        delta = target.target_quantity - current_market_qty
        if delta > 0:
            orders.append(
                self._new_order(product, market_contract, "BUY", delta, market.timestamp)
            )
        elif delta < 0:
            orders.append(
                self._new_order(product, market_contract, "SELL", abs(delta), market.timestamp)
            )
        return orders

    def create_order(
        self,
        target: TargetPosition,
        account: Account,
        market: BarMarketEvent,
    ) -> Order | None:
        """非换月期生成订单。内部直接调用换月期生成订单方法。"""
        orders = self.create_orders(target=target, account=account, market=market)
        if len(orders) > 1:
            raise ValueError("create_order 仅适用于单订单场景；换月场景请使用 create_orders。")
        return orders[0] if orders else None

    def _new_order(
        self,
        product: str,
        contract: str,
        side: str,
        quantity: int,
        created_at,
    ) -> Order:
        return Order(
            order_id=f"O{next(self._order_seq):08d}",
            product=product,
            contract=contract,
            side=side,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            quantity=quantity,
            created_at=created_at,
        )

def _bar(contract: str, raw_close: float) -> BarMarketEvent:

        product="RB",

def test_long_open_close_path():
    account = Account(initial_cash=1_000_000, multiplier_provider=lambda contract: 10)
    account.apply_fill(Fill("F1", "O1", "RB", "RB2510", "BUY", 1, 3500, pd.Timestamp("2026-01-02"), 2))
    account.mark_to_market(_bar("RB2510", 3520))

    assert account.position_quantity("RB") == 1
